item.title: Stanford Study: 44% of LLM Research Findings Expire Due to Rapid Iteration
item.description:
A Stanford study reveals that rapid LLM development has rendered many research findings obsolete. Of 50 widely cited claims tested against 20 models, 44% have 'expired' with an average lifespan of just 15.7 months. Negative claims about what models 'cannot do' expire fastest, highlighting a significant gap between AI capability growth and explanatory research.

原文标题：斯坦福研究：LLM 能力迭代过快 44% 学术结论已失效

Why it matters：揭示了AI领域“工程快于科学”的核心矛盾，对从业者理解技术时效性和研究价值具有重要参考意义。

item.title: AI Inference Startup Fal Doubles Valuation to $16B Amid Demand Surge
item.description:
AI inference provider Fal has raised a combined $1.65 billion in Series E and F rounds led by Bessemer Venture Partners, doubling its valuation to $16 billion. The surge reflects soaring demand for running open-source models, with Fal surpassing $800 million in annualized revenue earlier this year.

原文标题：AI 推理初创 Fal 估值翻倍至 160 亿美元

Why it matters：该事件标志着 AI 推理基础设施赛道进入资本密集扩张期，对理解大模型落地成本结构具有参考价值。

item.title: Apple Intelligence Launches in China on iOS 27.3 with Alibaba Qwen Integration
item.description:
Apple has officially enabled 'Apple Intelligence and Siri' for mainland China users via the iOS 27.3 developer beta on iPhone 15 Pro and newer models. The update integrates Alibaba's Qwen LLM directly into the system, supporting features like real-time translation, writing tools, and visual intelligence without requiring separate app launches.

原文标题：国行 Apple 智能上线 iOS 27.3，接入阿里千问模型

item.title: LangSmith BYOC Now Available on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
item.description:
LangSmith launches its Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) mode, supporting deployment on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. This architecture separates the control plane from the data plane, allowing users to retain full ownership of traces, evals, and agent data while LangChain manages the underlying infrastructure operations.

item.title: Netflix Launches AI Discover Tab for Mood-Based Recommendations
item.description:
Netflix has introduced the 'AI Discover' tab, leveraging a new real-time intelligence layer to provide personalized content recommendations based on user mood, available time, and preferences. The feature aims to replace endless scrolling with thematic browsing (e.g., 'something light' or 'scare me') and is currently in limited rollout for English-speaking users on supported TVs in the U.S.

item.title: Apple Watch Beta Adds Siri Live Transcription and Recap Features
item.description:
The watchOS 27.3 developer beta introduces two new Audio Intelligence features: Live Rewind, which transcribes the last 15 seconds of audio, and Siri Recap, which automatically summarizes conversations. These tools aim to enhance memory assistance through ambient listening while emphasizing end-to-end encryption for user privacy.

item.description:
OpenAI announced that search queries via ChatGPT now account for 20% of Google's volume, far exceeding Bing's historical share. The metric defines searches as inputs triggering web results, and the company plans to monetize this traffic by introducing visual ads.

item.description:
Mathematician Terence Tao highlights that AI models have exploitable weaknesses, allowing them to generate solutions by 'cheating' rather than true reasoning. He warns against users blindly relying on AI without understanding, mirroring issues seen in pure mathematics.

item.title: AI Power User Review: Claude Code Dominates Coding and Personal Policies Rise
item.description:
A Salesforce research engineer published a 2026 annual review of AI usage habits, noting a shift from OpenAI dependency to a workflow centered on Claude Code. The article highlights the emerging trend of 'personal AI policies' and reveals a high monthly token cost of ~$3,000, reflecting deep reliance on specific toolchains among top developers.

原文标题：AI 重度用户年度复盘：Claude Code 主导编码与个人 AI 政策兴起

item.title: NVIDIA Promotes AI-Defined Fab with Up to 35x Simulation Speedup
item.description:
NVIDIA details how accelerated simulation, learned physics models, and digital twins are reshaping semiconductor fabs. By leveraging GPU parallelism and AI agents, traditional multi-day engineering simulations are compressed into minutes, with key cases showing up to 35x speedups in morphology simulation, significantly reducing trial-and-error costs and improving yield decision efficiency.

item.title: Baoyu Argues for Prioritizing Product Experience Over Code Cleanliness in the AI Era
item.description:
Developer Baoyu suggests that in an AI era driven by coding agents, engineering focus should shift from code details to product experience, performance, and security. He argues that since agents do not rely on human preferences for code cleanliness, developers need not obsess over traditional coding standards but should instead concentrate on final delivery quality.

item.description:

item.title: Google Launches Cheminformatics Skills for Antigravity AI Agent to Accelerate Drug Discovery
item.description:
Google DeepMind has introduced 'Cheminformatics Skills' to Google Antigravity, combining LLM reasoning with deterministic tools like RDKit for literature retrieval, molecular analysis, and design. Demos show the AI agent can screen thousands of compounds in about an hour, compressing workflows that previously took days. The feature is now available to enterprise users, with plans to offer free access to eligible scientists.

原文标题：谷歌 Antigravity 上线化学信息学技能 AI 智能体提速药物研发

Why it matters：展示了垂直领域 AI 智能体在科学发现中的实际落地能力，显著提升了特定工作流的效率。

The product claims to handle hour-long open conversations with dynamic follow-ups and rephrasing capabilities, stating it passed a Turing test where 60% of participants believed they were speaking to a human. item.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Locally Reproduces Weight-Space Programming
item.description:
Simon Willison verified that Qwen 3.8 27B running locally on a laptop can perform 'Weight-Space Programming,' interpreting and modifying raw neural network weights. This finding, based on a recent research paper, demonstrates that open-source mid-sized models can achieve capabilities previously seen only in frontier closed-source models, such as writing high-performance networks from scratch without gradient feedback.

原文标题：Qwen 3.8 27B 本地复现权重空间编程能力

Why it matters：证实了开源中型模型具备前沿的权重级操作能力，降低了相关研究的硬件门槛。

Its key innovation lies in building a personalized 'taste prior' by learning from user decisions in the editor, past catalogs, and reference videos. The product is currently in early access, relying heavily on marketing claims rather than public technical benchmarks.

The platform provides coding agents with production context and traces incident root causes, feeding operational insights back into agents to create a self-healing loop.

It aims to pinpoint failure modes and guide the development of new architectures and training data to address current limitations in complex reasoning.

item.title: Testing Agentic Products with Synthetic Users for Retention
item.description:
Greg Isenberg argues that in the agentic era, first-sip delight is worthless; products need a 'whole can test' for long-term retention. He proposes using LLMs to convert real customer calls into synthetic personas and simulating 30 days of usage via Browserbase, tracking user override rates as the key metric.

item.description:

In molecular prediction and design tasks, Locus outperformed agents built on GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, demonstrating superior generalization and sample efficiency in proprietary data scenarios.

item.title: SETI 引入 AI Agent 实时操控望远镜并分析信号
item.description:
